summary_source.protocol: Targeted 2026-10-09 experiment, ocejon A30 GPU0, 1200 MHz; two 2g.12gb replicas, FP32, batch 1. e values average both counterbalanced single-replica repetitions relative to time-interpolated bracketing no-instance baselines. alpha uses separate single-busy stages with both replicas resident. Prediction uses the final pre-deployment no-instance baseline, not fitted to concurrent data. Measurement averages both concurrent runs.

scope: Figure calibration coefficients and concurrent-run means. The original measurements for those two means are included under evidence/validation/residency.
